'''D0-M9''' or '''Dom''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companion of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Kaya]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]], the duo was part of a crew that made a run to [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]], of which Kaya was the only survivor after an attack by the native [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. Dom helped Kaya escape by attacking her pursuers with their [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], however upon leaving the atmosphere they encountered a fleet belonging to the [[Order of Revan]]. Kaya and D0-M9 wisely decided to lay low for a while and headed to [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], where they visited the [[Blaster's Path]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].
